proposal.headline: Rotate the fold axis westward at its northwest end and extend the nose
proposal.observation: The observed older-unit belts approach the upper-left corner, whereas the predicted nose terminates farther southeast, near x=0.8 km, y=3.3 km. The observed belt also trends more east–west than the predicted belt across the northwest crop.
proposal.expected_effect: Move the northwestern closure toward the upper-left corner and align the central blue-unit belt more closely with the observed northwest–southeast trace.
